Clone from VisitCreation flow and update Screen elements to align with PHOCS requirements
V9 - Adding Insp types to Drinking Water V10- Removing the banner Msg for Non-Dairy in Insp path. V12- Adding Asset path for Rec water as part of EHIS-3692. V14- Adding Planned Started Time as part of EHIS-4313. V15- Adding Inspection Update to ChildCare as part of EHIS-4523. V16- Separating Child Care & Residential Care Inspections as part of EHIS-4523. V19 - Adding instructional text conditionally EHIS-3867 V21 - Removing Inspection creation from Asset (Recreational Water) EHIS-4849
